title: Following Apple’s Q4 2026 guidance, JP Morgan cuts its target for the company’s stock - 9to5Mac
summary: A few weeks ago, JP Morgan set a $345 price target for Apple’s stock through December 2027. As reported by AppleInsider , JP Morgan has lowered its price target for Apple’s stock from $345 to $340.
